decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems extends the firm's core digital earmold production at negligible holding cost, so the option stays open while its demand is still unresolved.
The individual EARsleeve has a dedicated page and fits the growing market for universal in-ear hearing systems, and keeping it costs little, so there is no case for abandoning it.

The orthopedic shoe last is a distant, more uncertain option, but it was launched only in 2024 and has its own page, so it is too early for results to show that its value will not be realized, and its digital manufacturing base keeps holding costs moderate.

The post-curing unit complements the firm's resin and 3D-printing workflow at low marginal cost, and one year of evidence is too thin to justify abandoning it, even though equipment like the withdrawn thermoforming unit carries some risk.
